newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat values steady.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 17 - FOB Gulf basis values for corn, soybeans and wheat were steady in quiet activity, traders said.
A lack of sizable pending export orders kept business slow.
Morocco bought 35,000 tonnes of soft wheat on Wednesday at $186.75 to $189.50 per tonne C&F for delivery in the first half of October. The quantities were U.S. or French optional wheat.

A Philippine flour mill bought 25,000 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat at $4.10 a bushel and 10,000 tonnes of western white wheat at $4.18 a bushel. The deal was made late on Tuesday for October delivery.
The Commodity Credit Corp bought 25,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat under the export donation program to Bosnia at $177.64 a tonne for Oct 5-31 shipment.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
